results.description:
Snippet Keyboard does exactly one job: it puts your saved phrases one tap away, in every app.

Switch to it with the globe key when you need it, tap a bubble, and your full snippet is inserted — greetings, work replies, addresses, emails, anything you type over and over. Then switch right back to your normal keyboard.

WHY IT'S DIFFERENT
• No typing engine, no autocorrect, no bloat — it's a snippet panel, not a keyboard replacement
• Tiny and fast: inserts are instant
• Organize snippets into categories with emoji labels
• Filter bubbles narrow a category in one tap: A+B needs both, A,B needs either
• Multi-line snippets, and long-press any bubble to preview the full text
• Undo takes back the last insert; the Clear key wipes what you were typing, and Undo brings it back
• Keyboard size: Compact, Standard or Tall
• Starter packs: ready-made customer-support replies in English, Chinese, French, Spanish and Vietnamese
• Import/export your library as a simple YAML text file — the same file works on iOS and Android
• Dark and light mode, iPhone and iPad
• Available in 15 languages

NEW: POP-UP BUBBLES
Press and hold a pop-up bubble, slide to a snippet, let go — it's inserted. Snippets inside a pop-up are hidden from the main keyboard, so even a big library sits behind a few fixed buttons that never move. Filters still work exactly as before.

DYNAMIC SNIPPETS
Create a snippet from any https:// URL you choose — tapping it fetches and inserts live content (your public IP, a status line, anything your server returns).
• Extraction rules pick out just the value you need from a JSON or HTML reply
• Add text before and after the reply, so a live value lands inside a full sentence
• Optionally send the text you're typing to your URL and replace it with the reply — handy for rewriting or translating a sentence. It's off by default and set per snippet, under Advanced; Undo puts your text back

PRIVACY FIRST
• No analytics, no tracking, no ads, no accounts
• Your snippets stay on your device
• The network is used ONLY when you tap a dynamic https:// snippet you created yourself
• No typing engine: the keyboard doesn't store what you type, and only sends it for a dynamic snippet you've set to do so
• Full Access is optional — it's needed only for dynamic snippets. Static snippets work fully without it

PLANS
• Free: 20 inserts a day, unlimited snippets
• Pro: 100 inserts a day — one-time purchase, no subscription
• Unlimited: no daily limit — auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly
Bought Pro before these plans existed? You keep unlimited inserts.
Prices are shown in the app in your local currency.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The Unlimited subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

results.description:
Anything you type twice belongs in KeepText.

Addresses. Bank details. The reply you send five times a week. Prompts, code,
links, your kid's allergy list. Save it once — then paste it anywhere, without
leaving the app you're in.


THE KEEPTEXT KEYBOARD

This is the one that changes the day-to-day. Switch to the KeepText keyboard
inside Mail, Messages, WhatsApp, Safari, Slack — anywhere you can type. Your
snippets are right there, ordered by what you actually use, so the one you
want is usually the first one. Tap it and the text lands at your cursor.

No app switching. No back-and-forth copy and paste. No losing your place.


SAVE IT IN UNDER A SECOND

- Share sheet — select text in any app, tap Share, choose KeepText. Done.
- Clipboard — copy something, open KeepText, and it offers to save it. One tap
  to keep, one tap to dismiss. It never reads your clipboard until you say yes.
- Type it — one field does both jobs. Search your library, and if nothing
  matches, that same field creates the snippet on the spot.


ONE TAP AWAY, EVERYWHERE ELSE TOO

- Widgets — home screen and lock screen. Tap to copy.
- Spotlight — swipe down anywhere and search your snippets by name.
- Shortcuts and Siri — "Save clipboard to KeepText," or add it to your Action
  button for one-press capture.


SEARCH THAT TELLS YOU THE TRUTH

Most apps guess. KeepText matches exactly — the word you typed, or the start
of it, and nothing looser. That sounds like a limitation until you use it: when
KeepText says nothing matched, it genuinely isn't saved yet, so you can create
it right there instead of wondering whether you're about to make a duplicate.


TEMPLATES

Put {{name}} or {{date}} anywhere in a snippet. When you use it, KeepText asks
you for the values and fills them in. Good for the email you send constantly
with one line that changes.


SYNCS EVERYWHERE. NO ACCOUNT. EVER.

Your snippets sync across your devices through your own iCloud account. There
is no KeepText account, no sign-up, no password, no server of ours in the
middle. Nothing to breach, because there's nowhere for your text to go.

The keyboard asks for Full Access because that is the only way iOS lets a
keyboard read the snippets stored on your own device. KeepText uses it for
exactly that. Nothing is collected, nothing is transmitted, there's no
analytics — the app has no account system to send anything to in the first
place. You can export everything you've saved to a plain JSON file whenever
you like.


FREE, THEN ONE SMALL PURCHASE

Keep up to 20 snippets free for as long as you want. One small purchase
unlocks unlimited snippets, forever. No subscription. No trial that quietly
starts charging. No ads.


NO FOLDERS

You'll notice there's no filing system. That's deliberate. Search and
frequency do the organizing, so saving something costs you one tap instead of
one decision — which is the whole reason your snippets actually get saved

results.description:
Stop retyping the same messages.

ClipTap is a snippet keyboard and text expander for the phrases you send every day. Save a template once, switch to the ClipTap keyboard, and drop it into any app - email, chat, social, an AI chat. No app-switching, no copy-and-paste.

The ClipTap keyboard inserts saved text and values only; switch back to your usual keyboard to type.

CLIPTAP IS FOR YOU IF YOU

- Send the same emails and canned replies, with a different signature for each role
- Reuse the same captions, hashtag sets and bios
- Send quotes, invoices and reminders, and keep client details on your device
- Fill the same name, phone and address into sign-up forms
- Reach for the same code snippets, commands and AI prompts

WHAT YOU CAN DO

A text expander you tap, not abbreviations you memorize
Save any phrase: a greeting, a canned reply, a whole email, a code snippet, a prompt. One tap copies it, or tap its title to copy just the title. "Open in App" lets you tweak it, then share it to ChatGPT, mail or any other app.

Shortcuts: insert just the value
Save the values you retype - name, phone number, address - and insert the value alone from the keyboard, so you can fill a sign-up form top to bottom without leaving the app. One shortcut holds several values, each maskable on screen (display only), and values accept variables.

The snippet keyboard, in any app
Filter by category, switch profile and reorder the list without leaving the keyboard, and toggle between templates and shortcut values. Title and line-break buttons fill a subject line and then the body in one go. On iOS it works without Full Access; grant it and keyboard use counts towards the usage ranking.

Variables for the parts that change
Seven system variables - {{today}}, {{now}}, {{time}}, {{year}}, {{month}}, {{day}}, {{weekday}} - fill in the date and time as you insert. Custom variables like {{name}} or {{company}} hold your own details: enter once, reuse everywhere.

94 date and time formats
Pick the output format for each system variable from 94 presets in total, 34 for the date alone: 2026/08/04, 08/04/2026, 09:05, Tue. Preview against the real date; every template using it follows at once.

Profiles for every hat you wear
Profiles like "Company A", "Side project" and "Personal" each keep their own variable and shortcut values, so one template comes out with a different company name and signature.

Categories, search and sorting
Group templates into Work, Social, Prompts or Code, color-coded from 12 presets. Search spans every active profile, matching the text you see with variables expanded. Sort four ways, including most used.

The web version: free, nothing to install
Organize a large library on a big screen in a PC browser, then move it to your phone as a .cliptap file. No app yet? Start from the free starter file. Shortcuts too.

EVERYTHING STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE

Templates, shortcuts, variables and profiles stay in your phone's storage. No cloud sync. ClipTap goes online only for subscription checks, sign-in and ads; every core feature works offline, and no account is needed.

It asks for no location, camera, photo or microphone permission.

Backup & Restore: back up everything as a .cliptap file and restore it on another device with your password. Restoring replaces all data there. A checksum rejects damaged files.

FREE AND PRO

Free: 50 templates, 50 shortcuts with 5 values each, unlimited categories, the snippet keyboard, all 7 variables with all 94 formats, 3 profiles, 5 custom variables. Templates and shortcuts already saved above a limit keep working; only new entries need Pro.
Pro (monthly or yearly): no ads and no limits. Prices vary by region; see the app for the current price. Billing runs through your store account, cancel any time.

FROM THE DEVELOPER

I built ClipTap so the time you spend retyping goes back to work that matters.

iPhone, iPad and Android (iOS 17.0+, Android 7.0+). Dark mode, English and Japanese.

Meet the all-new contact mode, split your keyboard with two fingers, and paste cleaner links!

• Your contacts, redesigned
Every detail of a contact now appears in colorful tiles. Tap a value to insert it, or tap a tile to insert all of it. Rearrange or hide tiles, hold a tile to choose how names, addresses and birthdays are inserted, and insert street names and house numbers separately. Turn on Search All Contacts to find anyone in your contacts right from the keyboard. They're only read while you search and are never stored.

• Split with two fingers
Place two fingers in the middle of the keyboard and pull them apart to split it, then push them back together to join it again. Turn on Split Gesture under Settings > Typing Behavior. Your keyboard also remembers whether it was split or one-handed for each width, like portrait and landscape.

• Cleaner links
When you paste from the keyboard, tracking parameters are removed from links, and they still lead to the same place. You can turn this off in the clipboard history settings.

• Smarter typing
Autocorrect is now about four times faster. If you undo a correction and type your word again, it stays as you typed it. Translations in the suggestion bar now offer up to two alternatives, and currency keys show the symbols for your region and languages.

• More control over your layouts
Show keys and rows only on the full-size or the compact keyboard, such as the floating keyboard on iPad. Choose for each row whether it gets pull-down keys, find number and symbol keys in their own category, and put Next Keyboard on any key. Editing keys in landscape is more comfortable, too.

• Fixes and refinements
The keyboard fits better on iOS 26 and iPhone Duo, resized letter keys show key previews again, and bundles follow your global theme again. The split keyboard got several fixes, the app shows language downloads as they happen, and we've fixed multiple syncing issues.
